title: Lost ID Card
executive_summary: Speaker A is talking to Sir's restaurant and says 'yes' to Speaker B's proposal to marry him and get him to have a vegetable or a spicy dish. Speaker B says he will tell you how it feels and asks Speaker A to pay him something. Speaker C says he will give two days in his parlor and asks Speaker A to find and pay for it. Speaker A agrees and asks Speaker C to help him find a parlor.
